problem:
Determine the graph of the following parametrically defined curve:

$$
x=1-2t,\,y=t,\,-3\le t\le 3
$$
worked_solution:
We need to create a table of values and then sketch the curve. First, we work out the $x$-values using the formula $x=1-2t.$ This gives

| **$t$** | $-3$ | $-2$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $7$ | $5$ | $3$ | $1$ | $-1$ | $-3$ | $-5$ |
| $y$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ |

$$

$$

Now, we work out the $y$ values using $y=t.$ This gives

| **$t$** | $-3$ | $-2$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $7$ | $5$ | $3$ | $1$ | $-1$ | $-3$ | $-5$ |
| $y$ | $-3$ | $-2$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |

$$

$$

Plotting these points, we obtain the following curve:
